scope: Corollary 8.4 (The separated angular form) of the manuscript “The Falconer distance conjecture in all dimensions” (preprints/The-Falconer-distance-conjecture-in-all-dimensions-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 073 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 98a7e721547308b9), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 46. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Under the hypotheses of Proposition 8.1, suppose also that X, Y and their supported laws have the separated geometry used to define HX,Y F (a, v) in Section 7. Then (8.4) holds with its left-hand side replaced by HX,Y F (a, v) and with the same child energies. This includes the outer root a = 0 with separated actual supports inside possibly equal depth-zero cells X, Y .
